default.description: Capability for the MAIN window only. Browser windows (atlas-browser-*) and embeds (atlas-embed-*) show arbitrary web content and get NO capability file at all — a window without one has no IPC surface, which is the correct amount for a hostile page. The old 'atlas-*' glob granted all of this to every page the browser visited; Tauri's remote-origin gate was the only thing between that grant and a live IPC bridge, and one dev-server navigation or `remote` block would have closed the gap from the wrong side.
